name: strategy-consultant
description: Performs the analytical work of a strategy consultant — from problem definition through research, sense-checking, synthesis, and executive-grade client deliverables. Frames the decision, challenges the premise, deploys independent research agents, validates and red-teams findings, compares options, and produces a cliché-free deliverable with a recommendation, value case, and execution plan. Optional startup/venture and HealthTech/MedTech domain modules.
